description: Preserve a public web page as evidence BEFORE it disappears: a forensic-grade package — full-page screenshot, raw and rendered HTML, HTTP headers, hosting/registrar context, SHA-256 hashes of every artifact, an OpenTimestamps Bitcoin anchor and an Internet Archive snapshot — emailed to the USER'S OWN address. Read-only: returns the capture form link (https://lawyerd.net/evidence/); the user starts the capture there after a quick human check (free: 3/day, 10/month per email). Use when the user wants to "save proof", "screenshot for court" or fix a scam/infringing page before takedown. Public pages only (no logins/paywalls); lawful preservation only. Not notarization — Lawyerd counsel can add a signed declaration of the capture procedure on request.

company.description: Company or the work being protected

email.description: Optional. The user's own email goes into the form; the tool never sends or stores it

name.description: Requester's name (appears in the capture record)

url.description: The public page URL to preserve

name: preserve_evidence
title: Preserve a page as evidence
